items.raw_excerpt: A new plan by care agencies and insurance companies aims to create 30 residential care zones in the Maastricht-Heuvelland area of Limburg, combining health services, activities and accessible living. The plan, known as the Deltaplan Maastricht Heuvelland, aims to help older people live independently for longer and receive support and care closer to home, largely to tackle loneliness. The initiative is a collaboration between municipalities, health insurers, residents, hospitals and elderly care
items.summary_en: A new plan aims to create 30 residential care zones in the Maastricht-Heuvelland area of Limburg, Netherlands. The zones will combine health services, activities and easy-to-reach housing. Local councils, health insurers, hospitals and residents work together to help older people live on their own for longer.
